headline: 46,888 of 48,889 JavaScript lines now run as C#. 4 agents are working in parallel and no file is left that needs one consistent head, so the pool binds the clock, not any single file. Of the 2,001 lines still in the budget, two independent line-by-line audits could only find about 30 that are genuinely unported — treat the rest as accounting slack, not work.
